notes.title: METAVUSKING Update Plan
notes.content:
METAVUSKING will be officially released with an update on April 28, 2022. There are still many shortcomings, but we promise to make up for them in the future. 

As for the progress and future update plans, a community based on vocal data was considered as a major function of METAVUSKING since its inception. The basic function is to share the recorded vocal data with other players through the server and use it to proceed with the duet mode. These features are essential to the server, but the cost of the server system is higher than expected, delaying the update of related features. We are trying to solve problems such as funding, so please continue to support and cheer us on!

The upcoming updates are as follows:

1. Partner Studio
- You can record the vocal data of a duet in the recording studio and share it over the Internet.
- If other players sing duet songs with the vocal data you shared, you can get a reward.

2. Upgraded Solo Mode
- A total of 40,000 additional songs including K-POP, POP, and J-POP will be provided.
- As many songs were added, the UI related to solo mode is revamped for easy and fast song selection.

3. Virtual Idols
- Idols will debut at METAVUSKING Universe through artificial intelligence-based vocaloid technology!!
- With the appearance of virtual idols, you can choose even more songs in duet mode.

4. Theater Editor
- You can decorate your own concert hall by combining various objects and backgrounds.
- Shoot a new concert video with a unique venue in the background!

5. Coin system
- If you spend one coin, you can perform songs that you haven't bought yet.
- Coins can be purchased through Microtransactions (In-Game Purchases).

notes.title: Metavusking v1.6.1.7 Released
notes.content:
Metabusking has been updated to v 1.6.1.7!

[u]Patch Notes[/u]

[list]
[*]The new songs updated.
- 26 songs (16 duet songs) added from the previous 10 songs [Total 36 songs]

[*]Japanese transliteration added.
- When selecting Japanese in Language Selection, Japanese transliteration will be selected automatically
- Transliteration can be changed in Transliteration Option

[*]Three new Concert halls added.
- The cathedral theme, the space base theme, and the karaoke theme concert halls added
- Island-themed Concert Hall Deleted

[*]Chorus ON/OFF function added.
- Can be manipulated in System Setting

[*]Others
- System Optimization
- Operation key added in PC Version 
- Judgment system improved
[/list]

notes.title: Metavusking v1.6.0.4 Released
notes.content:
Metabusking has been updated to v1.6.0.4!

[u]Patch note[/u]
[list]
[*]Japanese will be added to the language setting.
- Can be set in the Settings-etc.
- When you choose Japanese, the note difference changes to English.

[*] Achievement will be added.
- Challenges can be achieved only with the records played after the update.

[*]Score system improves more easily.

[*] Other additional items will be modified.
- Adjusting the spacing of sentences.
[/list]

notes.title: Metavusking v1.3.4.28 Released
notes.content:
Metavusking has been updated to v1.3.4.28!

[u]Patch note[/u]
[list]
[*]PC mode will be added.
- You can play games without a VR Headset.
- Live view/Basic view can adjust the performance screen.
- Basic keyboard/mouse control key support.
- Support for full screen and window mode.

[*]Transliteration will be added.
- When setting up an English(US) language, show the Transliteration.

[*] The UI for song selection will be reorganized.
- Add a song thumbnail.
- Add the display function only for the songs you have.
- Song title/Singer English version support.
 
[*] The settings will be reorganized.
- The volume of the microphone, the volume of the accompaniment, etc.

[*] Other additional items will be modified.
- Add some UI interaction effects and modify functions. 
- Add pop-up information, adjust the spacing of sentences, etc. 
[/list]

notes.title: Metavusking v1.2.1.6 Released
notes.content:
Metavusking has been updated to v1.2.1.6!

[u]Patch note[/u]
[list]
[*] A new celebrity will be added to the basic song.
- Some Part A - 댕댕펀치
- Rollin' Part A, B - 긍정폭발사슴
- DDU-DU DDU-DU Part A, B - 긍정폭발사슴

[*] A new concert hall - a school auditorium will be added.

[*]The image type recorded during recording setting is changed from a 3D VR image to a 2D planar image.

[*]Live screen settings will be changed.
- Add an outline.
- Change to default OFF (adjustable in the configuration)

[*] UI convenience is improved.
- Add some UI interaction effects and modify functions. 
- Add pop-up instructions, change the color of lyrics, adjust the spacing of sentences, etc. 

[*] Other additional items will be modified.
- If you choose a celebrity, add an animation.
- Correcting the part lyrics error.
- Correcting the celebrity singing part error.
- Modify player profile duplicate selection.
- Modify the sorting button of the song selection panel.
- Reeds Field Performance Hall. Move below the location of reeds.
[/list]
